about: Vectors for folder attribution (DEC-0089), written by tools/vectors/folder-attribution.ts, never by hand. origin: normalizeOrigin(origin), a repository identity host/path or null. attribution: attributeFolder(snapshot); snapshot is {folder, home, tempRoots, git, projects, work?, tombstones?, containers?, explicit?}, git null for a folder without Git or {toplevel, commonDir, mainCheckout, origin}; a project is {id, folders: [{path, commonDir, origin, toplevel?}], sources}, toplevel the folder's Git top level (a folder in Git gives its commonDir and toplevel); a work record is {project, commonDir, origin?}; record: explainFolder(snapshot).record, the Project folder a product records after the answer ({path, commonDir, origin, toplevel}) or null; paths are absolute and /-separated. Members a rule does not read (a branch) change nothing.
